metadata.description: Master BigFix Syntax and Property Dictionary

operating system.description: The operating system type provides information about the operating system and computer.

properties.name: service pack major version
properties.syntax: service pack major version of <operating system>

properties.name: service pack minor version
properties.syntax: service pack minor version of <operating system>

registry.description: The <registry> objects are the inspectors that expose the Windows registry.

properties.name: current user key
properties.syntax: current user key <logged on user> of <registry>

registry key.description: The <registry key> objects represent Windows registry keys whose existence and properties can be inspected.
creation: current user key <logged on user> of <registry> : registry key
current user key of <registry> : registry key
driver key of <active device> : registry key
parent key of <registry key value> : registry key
user key of <logged on user> : registry key

registry key value.description: The <registry key value> inspectors are used to access values stored within a registry key. All values have sizes and types.
creation: default value of <registry key> : registry key value
value <string> of <registry key> : registry key value
value of <registry key> : registry key value

casts.syntax: <registry key value> as system x32 file
<registry key value> as system x64 file

security descriptor.description: Structures and associated data that contain security information for a securable object, identifying the owner, primary group, DACL, and SACL.
creation: security descriptor of <network share> : security descriptor
security descriptor of <registry key> : security descriptor
security descriptor of <scheduled task> : security descriptor
security descriptor of <task folder> : security descriptor
security descriptor of <task registration info> : security descriptor

drive.description: The <drive> object is available to inspect aspects of the file system.

file.description: For each file in the file system, you can create a corresponding file object and inspect its properties, including version data of executable files.
creation: <registry key value> as system file : file
<registry key value> as system x32 file : file
<registry key value> as system x64 file : file

folder.description: For every folder in the file system, you can create a folder object and examine dozens of properties. On the Macintosh, specialized folder access depends on the domain.
creation: apple menu items folder of <domain> : folder

json key.description: The json key type represents a key-value pair in a JSON object.

json value.description: The json value type represents a JSON value: string, number, object, array, boolean, or null.
creation: instance data of <cloud provider> : json value

wmi.description: A <wmi> object provides access to the WMI (Windows Management Instrumentation) query facility.

wmi select.description: The <wmi select> object represents a value returned as a result of a WMI select query.

wmi object.description: The <wmi object> inspectors allow you to analyze the properties of WMI objects.

xml dom node.description: The <xml dom node> objects are inspectors for XML Document Object Model (DOM) nodes.
creation: xml of <event log record> : xml dom node

properties.name: xpath
properties.syntax: xpath <( string, string )> of <xml dom node>

xml dom document.description: XML document inspector. The encoding of the file must match the encoding declared in the XML document's first line.
creation: owner document of <xml dom node> : xml dom document
xml document of <file> : xml dom document
xml document of <string> : xml dom document

service.description: The <service> inspectors provide access to all services configured on supported operating systems.

process.description: A process object is a running process.

properties.name: quota peak nonpaged pool usage
properties.syntax: quota peak nonpaged pool usage of <process>

properties.name: quota peak paged pool usage
properties.syntax: quota peak paged pool usage of <process>

network.description: The <network> objects are the keywords used to query the local network configuration.

network adapter.description: One or more network adapters may be inspected. Each has properties such as the MAC address.
creation: adapter of <network adapter interface> : network adapter

network address list.description: A network adapter may be configured to respond to a list of network addresses. This object type provides access to such a list.
creation: address list of <network adapter> : network address list
dns server of <network adapter> : network address list
dns server of <network> : network address list
gateway list of <network adapter> : network address list

network interface.description: The network interface object describes a generic network interface with name and family information.

network ip interface.description: Holds locally determined properties of logical network devices. On Mac, corresponds to AF_INET interfaces.
creation: ip interface <integer> of <network> : network ip interface
ip interface of <network adapter> : network ip interface
ip interface of <network> : network ip interface
primary internet connection : network ip interface

properties.name: point to point
properties.syntax: point to point of <network ip interface>

user.description: Represents a computer user. On Windows: local and domain users. On Linux: users in the context of an active session.
creation: domain user of <active directory local user> : user

filesystem object.description: The <filesystem object> inspectors provide handles for the various objects available in the file system.
creation: hfs relative item <string> of <folder> : filesystem object
item ending in <string> of <folder> : filesystem object
posix relative item <string> of <folder> : filesystem object

application.description: Application objects derive from file objects and inherit all file properties. Creation methods are optimized for this important object type.
